definitions.explanation: describes a person who is focused on their inner world and who often prefers solitary activities or small group interactions

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
{内向|ないこう} (introversion) + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (suffix: -like, -ish)

PSYCHOLOGY:
This is a psychological term referring to how a person directs their attention and derives energy. {内向的|ないこうてき} people recharge through solitude and reflection.

SIMILAR WORDS:
{内向的|ないこうてき} (introverted) ↔ ⟦{外向的|がいこうてき}→外向的：08459_gaikouteki⟧ (extroverted)

USAGE:
Unlike common misconceptions, introversion is not the same as shyness or social anxiety. Many introverts are skilled socially but prefer deeper one-on-one connections.

FORMS:
{内向的|ないこうてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ - in an introverted manner
